item.description: The meeting: a meeting-prep-select accepted entry {index, item: {event_id, title, start, ...}, item_key, query} (a for_each branch; the meeting is item.item), the meeting object itself, or a slot {i, item_key, label, query}. item_key is top-level and copied unchanged into item_result.item_key. null means the slot is empty.
In an accepted entry: the meeting record (title, start, start_local, company_domain, company_name_guess, external_attendees, agenda, ...).

context.description: Who we are and what we sell. Shapes goals and questions.

focus.description: What to look for, e.g. 'their data stack, hiring for RevOps, latest funding'. Default: attendee roles, what the company does, latest news, history with us.

icp.description: Your ICP as text. Optional; when empty, an ICP stated in a dependency's document output is used. No ICP: no fit line.

lookback_days.description: How old a recent event may be, in days.

max_attendees.description: How many external attendees to describe.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Optional: on JoyStream the template binds it to the run start time, and without it the skill uses the run start time from its instructions. Never guessed.
